spellsPrepared.desc: Frost-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.
spellsPrepared.name: Sacred Frost

spellsPrepared.desc: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 1d12 necrotic damage.
spellsPrepared.name: Toll the Dead

spellsPrepared.desc: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
spellsPrepared.name: Spare the Dying

spellsPrepared.desc: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.
spellsPrepared.name: Guidance

spellsPrepared.desc: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn’t understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it. Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can’t follow your command, the spell ends. Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends its turn. Halt. The target doesn’t move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air.
spellsPrepared.name: Command

spellsPrepared.desc: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
spellsPrepared.name: Cure Wounds

spellsPrepared.desc: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.
spellsPrepared.name: False Life

spellsPrepared.desc: You conjure a shard of solid ice and hurl it toward a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn as ice clings to the wound.  If you hit an object that isn't being worn or carried, the shard deals damage as normal and, if the object is a container of liquid, the liquid inside freezes solid (potentially cracking a fragile container).
spellsPrepared.name: Ice Arrow

spellsPrepared.desc: Creature. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d6 force damage and is flung up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice, then falls prone. If the destination is blocked by a solid surface (a wall or ceiling), the creature instead stops there and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage in addition to the spell's damage. On a success, the creature takes half damage and isn't flung or knocked prone.  Object. An unattended object weighing up to 200 pounds is flung up to 40 feet in a direction of your choice. If hurled at a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 bludgeoning damage.  At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the distance a creature or object can be flung increases by 15 feet, and the damage increases by 1d6, for each slot level above 2nd.
spellsPrepared.name: Fling

inventory.name: Arorus
inventory.desc: After conjuring your weapon will melt after 1d6 turns. You will be left unarmed until the start of your next turn.

inventory.name: Scale Mail
inventory.desc: This armor consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.  Stealth. The wearer has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
